_note: `void (a, b)` / `(a, b)` sequences report TS2695 on the unused left side wherever they are — inside a `$:` statement too. The default svelte-check filters the reactive ones through its language service, which `svelte-check --tsgo` never runs; an earlier version rewrote the sequences inside `$:` to array literals and reported only the one in the plain function.
